description: FR-05 boundary value analysis on username length. The requirement states a username longer than 30 characters must fail. Boundaries tested: 29 (below), 30 (on the boundary), 31 (first value above), 32 and 255 (well above). The username is built as 'a' * length, which is never a registered user, so every case is expected to show the error banner and stay on the login page. For lengths <= 30 the failure reason is 'unknown user', not 'too long' - see docs/Test_Design_and_Traceability.xlsx (OBS-01).

cases.note: just below the boundary (length valid, user unknown)
on the boundary (length valid, user unknown)
first value above the boundary - must fail per FR-05
above the boundary - must fail per FR-05
far above the boundary - must fail per FR-05
